timeZones.description:
**WARNING:** This is an advanced configuration option that will increase the total
             computation and the amount of data stored in {@link Cassandra} by a
             factor of `timeZones.length`. Only use this field if you are aware of
             your application's expected data size and data storage requirements and
             limits.

All {@link TimeZone}s that should be cached when running
{@link RollupMetricPersistedResult#startRollupMetricBatchJobs}. A separate
{@link Timeseries} will be created for each {@link TimeZone} in this list.
If no {@link TimeZone}s are specified, metrics will be cached exclusively
[without a time zone](TimeZone#NONE).

The {@link TimeZone}s to cache can be overridden for a given evaluation
through {@link RollupMetricStartPersistenceJobSpec#timeZones}.

**NOTE:** {@link RollupMetricPersistedResult} is **not flexible** to treat different
          but equal [offset formats](TimeZone#isOffset) (e.g., `-08:00`, `GMT-08:00`,
          `GMT-8`) or [time zone IDs](TimeZone#isId) (e.g., `UTC`, `Zulu`, `Etc/UTC`)
          the same. When caching metrics with time zones, you must ensure that the
          time zone ID or offset format for caching and evaluation is consistent.
